name: Mequinenza (Spain)
description: Quartered: green with a yellow tower at the upper hoist, green with a white conifer at the lower fly, and white with two blue wavy stripes at the upper fly and lower hoist.
history: The flag of Mequinenza is a cloth of proportion 2:3, quartered: the first green with a yellow tower with red door and windows, the fourth green with a white conifer fruited yellow, and the second and third white with two blue wavy stripes.

features.role: tower with red door and windows on the upper hoist quarter
door and windows of the tower
two wavy stripes on each white quarter
conifer fruited yellow on the lower fly quarter
